subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word.

He uses one of the finest __ingredients__ in his cooking.
solution:
The correct answer is Option (1) i.e. **Components**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ingredients **(अवयव, सामग्री) - Substances that are combined to create a dish or meal.

 
 
• **Example**: The ingredients for the soup include carrots, onions, and chicken broth.
 
 
 
• **Components **: (पुरज़ा) - Fundamental parts or elements that together form something.
 
 
• **Example**: The main components of the recipe are flour, sugar, and eggs.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is Components.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mixtures **: (मिश्रण) - A combination of different things, where the components are mixed but not chemically combined.

 
 
• **Example**: The cake batter is a mixture of dry and wet ingredients.
 
 
 
• **Culinary **: (खाद्य संबंधी) - Relating to cooking or the kitchen.
 
 
• **Example**: He is studying culinary arts to become a chef.
 
 
 
• **Preparations** : (तैयारियाँ) - The action or process of making something ready for use or consideration.
 
 
• **Example**: The preparations for the dinner included chopping vegetables and marinating the meat.
